headline: Farranac Coast, Godcrofts Flash; Fishermans Row Falls Silent
war_summary: Since the last edition, Farranac Coast has flared into the base ledger with three actions in the past two hours, all centered on Mara, while Godcrofts has quickened from two actions to five in the same interval, Argosa and Lipsia sharing the day's honors. Fishermans Row, the previous focus, has gone silent in the latest two-hour window; its six-hour count still stands at six, with Peripti Landing and Dankana Post the busiest points. DeadLands, briefly restless at 15:36, has also lapsed into quiet, The Salt March carrying the day with eleven recorded actions. Lykos Isle has not stirred since 11:15, Linn Mercy since the early morning, and Stlican Shelf's two actions date from the previous evening. Away from the base board, Clahstra and Weathered Expanse continue to exact a heavy butcher's bill without changing hands, their casualty rates still running high. The war is in its seventy-fourth day, and the latest dispatches point to Farranac Coast and Godcrofts as the fronts to watch.
